name: pl.fractio/katalog
title: fractio.pl: katalog ekspertów fractional
description: Fractional executives in Poland (CMO, CFO, CTO, COO): search experts, projects and guides.

tools.name: search_experts
tools.description: Search the fractio.pl catalog of fractional executives in Poland. Filter by role, free-text query (skills, industry, name; Polish or English keywords), city and maximum hourly rate. Returns name, headline, location, work mode, availability, hourly rate (PLN net) and the profile URL.

city.description: City in Poland; remote experts are listed with 'Zdalnie'.

max_hourly_rate.description: Upper limit in PLN net per hour. Experts without a published rate are kept.

tools.name: get_expert
tools.description: Full public profile of one fractio.pl expert: bio, experience, strengths, collaboration packages with monthly rates, skills, languages, availability. Pass the slug from the profile URL (fractio.pl/eksperci/<slug>).

slug.description: Profile slug, e.g. 'jan-kowalski', or the profile URL.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Active engagement requests published by companies on fractio.pl: scope, function, time commitment (days per week or month), work mode, location and rate range (PLN net). Experts reply to them with their own proposal.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Details of one engagement request: scope, expectations, time commitment, rate, company. Pass the id from the URL (fractio.pl/zlecenia/<id>).

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the fractio.pl knowledge base (rates, contracts, how the fractional model works, role guides) and The Workshop articles written by experts from the catalog. Returns title, summary and URL.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'ile kosztuje fractional CFO', 'umowa B2B'.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full text (Markdown) of a knowledge-base guide (fractio.pl/wiedza/<slug>) or a The Workshop article (fractio.pl/workshop/<slug>), with its FAQ when present.
